summary: Documents the Nile factory lifecycle, promotion gates, approvals, and audit expectations. Obligations in this document are process and workflow oriented rather than directly enforceable from Terraform plan JSON.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). No controls from this document can be reliably evaluated from plan fields alone.

controls.title: Factory proposals document required intake information
controls.obligation: A factory proposal must document business justification, cloud provider scope, resource types, governance alignment, and tagging coverage.
controls.reason: Proposal documentation requirements are not represented in Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Input schemas define and constrain all exposed inputs
controls.obligation: All inputs must have types, descriptions, and validation constraints, and inputs mapping to mandatory tags are required fields.
controls.reason: Schema metadata and required-input design are factory authoring concerns, not Terraform plan JSON attributes.

controls.title: Security-sensitive options require explicit approval
controls.obligation: Inputs exposing security-sensitive options such as public exposure or encryption bypass are prohibited unless explicitly approved by Security.
controls.reason: Approval state and schema exposure are process inputs unavailable in Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Factory validation gate blocks promotion until all checks and reviews pass
controls.obligation: All automated checks and manual reviews must pass before a factory is promoted to Alpha, and production-impacting promotion and deployment decisions require human review and approval.
controls.reason: Promotion workflow, manual reviews, and approval evidence are not encoded in Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Lifecycle promotions require deployment evidence and sign-off
controls.source_section: Stage 4 — Alpha; Stage 5 — Beta; Stage 6 — Stable
controls.obligation: Promotion between lifecycle stages requires successful deployments, issue thresholds, and formal sign-off or review depending on stage.
controls.reason: Deployment history, open issue state, and sign-off decisions are external process data, not plan fields.

controls.title: Breaking changes and deprecation timelines follow governance rules
controls.source_section: Stage 5 — Beta; Stage 6 — Stable; Stage 7 — Deprecated
controls.obligation: Breaking changes require deprecation notices or new major versions, and deprecation must include minimum migration windows and consumer notification.
controls.reason: Versioning policy, notices, and migration windows are release-management process requirements outside Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: Provisioning records are retained for audit
controls.obligation: Every factory execution generates a provisioning record with execution metadata, validation results, provisioned resources, applied tags, and retention for audit.
controls.reason: Audit record generation and retention are operational controls not observable in Terraform plan JSON.
